# Native Integrations

Open Dental has partnered with a limited number of third-party vendors to develop integrations that are easily accessible directly from the Open Dental program. See [Open Dental Integration Types](https://www.opendental.com/site/integrationtypes.html) for more details.

## Electronic Prescriptions (eRx)

See [eRx Companies](https://www.opendental.com/site/electronicrx.html) for more details.

- [DoseSpot eRx](https://www.opendental.com/site/dosespot.html)
- [Ensora eRx](https://www.opendental.com/site/newcropfeature.html)

## Payment Processing

See [Native Payment Integrations](https://www.opendental.com/site/nativepaymentintegrations.html) for more details.

- [Global Payments](https://www.opendental.com/site/globalpaymentsintegration.html)
- [PayConnect by DentalXChange](https://www.opendental.com/site/dentalxchange.html#payconnect)
- [PaySimple](https://www.opendental.com/site/paysimpleintegration.html)

## AI Image Analysis

See [AI Image Analysis Integrations](https://www.opendental.com/site/aiimageanalysis.html) for more details.

- [BetterDiagnostics](https://www.opendental.com/site/betterdiagnostics.html)
- [Pearl](https://www.opendental.com/site/pearl.html)

## Clearinghouses

The following clearinghouses are recommended as they also offer native integrations for claims, attachments, billing, and more. See [Clearinghouses](https://www.opendental.com/site/0_clearinghouses.html) for more details.

- [DentalXChange](https://www.opendental.com/site/dentalxchange.html)
- [Electronic Dental Services (EDS)](https://www.opendental.com/site/electronicdentalservices.html)

## Other

Click a link for additional details about a specific service.

- [Bola AI](https://www.opendental.com/site/bolaai.html) \- Bola Voice Assist is integrated for voice perio
- [CareCredit](https://www.opendental.com/site/carecredit.html) \- See page for details
- [Transworld Systems Inc. (TSI)](https://www.opendental.com/site/tsiintegration.html) \- Collections and billing service
- [Clerri](https://www.opendental.com/site/clerri.html) \- A platform for in-house dental membership plans
- [PaySuite](https://www.opendental.com/site/paysuite.html) \- Automatic claim payment posting for Canada users
- [Glidewell](https://www.opendental.com/site/glidewell.html) \- Send and manage lab cases electronically.
